requirement_summary: Identity is an Ed25519 keypair; the public key is the pseudonymous identity.
notes: Identity creation and sign/verify tests are present; this is local-code evidence only.

requirement_summary: NodeID is the first 16 bytes of BLAKE3-256 of the public key and is not a replacement identity.
notes: Exact derivation is implemented; no dedicated derivation test is claimed.

requirement_summary: Nicknames are non-unique UI labels; callers must retain a cryptographic disambiguator.
notes: Claim field exists; no audited application UI demonstrates collision disambiguation.

requirement_summary: BundleID and signatures use the zeroed-lifetime canonical form with inline origin public key.
notes: BundleID, signing preimage, inline key, and canonical codec are directly implemented.

requirement_summary: A receiver MUST canonical-decode and strictly verify before storage or forwarding; invalid input is dropped.
notes: The named integration test exercises verify-before-store.

requirement_summary: SeenIndex prevents duplicate resurrection; lifetime is age-based, clamped on receive, decremented by carriers, and expires at zero.
notes: Named test covers reset-lifetime resurrection; broader persistence faults are not claimed.

requirement_summary: Unknown critical TLVs are rejected and per-hop copy budget is mutable but receive-clamped to L_MAX.
notes: Parser and clamp have direct tests.

requirement_summary: Bundles larger than MAX_BUNDLE use the blob/symbol path rather than oversized bundle bytes.
notes: Oversize rejection and blob frame syntax exist, but node-level blob transfer is not integrated.

requirement_summary: Unauthenticated beacon hints and authenticated bulk streams are separate planes; beacons are never authorization evidence.
notes: Separate codecs and session bulk processing exist; no radio hardware conformance is inferred.

requirement_summary: TAL supplies beacon exchange, link events, an ordered reliable stream, and link-quality hints without bundle knowledge.
notes: Sans-IO event seam exists; ordered/reliable behavior remains a platform-adapter obligation.

requirement_summary: Binary Spray-and-Wait splits copies, clamps L_MAX, and switches to focus behavior at one copy.
notes: Unit tests cover budget arithmetic; empirical routing efficacy is not established.

requirement_summary: Copy budget derives from a bounded local population estimate rather than global topology claims.
notes: Formula is present; no population-estimator field validation is present.

requirement_summary: Routing utility uses locally observed encounter evidence and is never exchanged as peer-controlled routing truth.
notes: Local-only intent is explicit in source; no adversarial utility study was run.

requirement_summary: Admission checks signature, lifetime, tier/class policy, quotas, and contact transfer ordering.
notes: Quota paths are tested; complete tier and ordering integration is not demonstrated.

requirement_summary: Verified delivery receipts enable purge; receipt hints must not alone cause deletion.
notes: Exact-purge versus hint behavior has a direct test.

requirement_summary: Per-origin quota, web-of-trust multiplier, eviction, and fairness bound abusive relay load.
notes: Token-bucket quota exists; social graph and fairness under contention lack integration evidence.

requirement_summary: Group dissemination is scope-budgeted and receipt-aware rather than unbounded broadcast.
notes: Basic group path is tested; geographic group spread and scope-budget validation are absent.

requirement_summary: RBSR reconciles scoped BundleID sets by range fingerprints over resumable rounds.
notes: Convergence test covers finite local sets; contact-scale behavior is not claimed.

requirement_summary: Claims are single-writer LWW records with signed owner, field, sequence, and body.
notes: Codec and merge behavior exist; distributed failure coverage is limited.

requirement_summary: Conversation messages form a bounded-parent Merkle DAG with causal ordering and parent validation.
notes: DAG implementation is present; no full multi-writer adversarial study is evidenced.

requirement_summary: ReceiptFilter is an advisory anti-entropy hint and cannot authorize receipt purge.
notes: Direct regression test establishes the non-purge property.

requirement_summary: Friend proxy summaries are signed, age-marked, and permit bounded dependent reconciliation.
notes: Frames parse, but session handling explicitly ignores friendship/proxy frames.

requirement_summary: Group membership uses an observed-remove set with causally attributable operations.
notes: OR-Set code exists; group protocol integration is separately partial.

requirement_summary: Reconciliation domains constrain what strangers, peers, friends, and anchors may exchange.
notes: Domain types/session flow exist; policy coverage for all roles is not directly evidenced.

requirement_summary: Local active adversary capabilities, protected assets, and attack-to-defense mappings define security acceptance criteria.
notes: Threat model is course-defining specification context, not a code feature.

requirement_summary: Bundle poisoning, replay, malformed input, spoofing, and routing abuse receive explicit protocol defenses.
notes: Selected defenses have tests; no evidence supports complete attack-matrix closure.

requirement_summary: Metadata disclosure is bounded by plane and relationship, and friendship consent UI must disclose friend-visible data.
notes: No audited application UX implements the required consent disclosure.

requirement_summary: Residual risks remain explicit rather than being interpreted as solved security properties.
notes: Use as a risk-register exercise; it does not require code parity.

requirement_summary: Suite 0x01 uses Ed25519, X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305, BLAKE3, and strict domain-separated verification.
notes: Suite primitives and strict verifier are direct code evidence.

requirement_summary: Interactive sessions use the specified Noise XX handshake and identity proof binding.
notes: Local handshake tests exist; interoperability and external review do not.

requirement_summary: Asynchronous first contact uses signed prekeys and sealed delivery semantics.
notes: Primitive path is tested locally.

requirement_summary: Pairwise conversations use a ratchet with skipped-key and epoch behavior.
notes: Ratchet tests are local; persistence policy is separately unresolved in implementation evidence.

requirement_summary: Groups use sender keys and epochs; receipts use MACs; blobs use Merkle integrity and RS coding.
notes: Building blocks exist, but Merkle/RS are not connected to node blob transfer.

requirement_summary: Hybrid PQ is reserved, secrets require at-rest protection, and privacy/PCS limitations are honestly disclosed.
notes: No audited platform-keystore wrapping or hybrid suite implementation; disclosure is specification evidence.

requirement_summary: Production service identity requires a SIG 16-bit UUID; development must not be mistaken for the production layout.
notes: DISC-001: implementation deliberately uses a 128-bit development UUID that cannot fit the specified legacy service-data layout.

requirement_summary: Beacon has a fixed legacy advertising layout, rotating ephem_id, scheduled summary hints, and no stable cleartext NodeID.
notes: Codec/rotation arithmetic exist; 31-byte production advertisement is blocked by DISC-001.

requirement_summary: Discovery/dial negotiation and GATT bulk framing use bounded envelopes, flow control, MTU negotiation, and optional CoC.
notes: Byte utilities/adapters exist; physical central-peripheral connection was not audited as executed.

requirement_summary: Android, iOS, desktop, and embedded mappings must state platform role and background limitations.
notes: DISC-006: mobile/embedded adapters and cross-target execution evidence are absent or intentionally stubbed.

requirement_summary: Airtime fairness limits scanning, advertising, sessions, and bulk transfer under shared BLE spectrum.
notes: Transport policy is specified but no hardware/OS implementation evidence is available.

requirement_summary: BLE behavior requires hardware and mixed-platform validation rather than codec-only confidence.
notes: DISC-006: no audited hardware BLE execution or target matrix establishes this requirement.

requirement_summary: Bulk frame envelope and frame type schemas are exact, bounded, and parseable before session actions.
notes: Frame codec and negative parser tests are directly present.

requirement_summary: Bundle layout, signing-domain separation, and class payload schemas are canonical and type-specific.
notes: Code has domain separation and payload codecs.

requirement_summary: Beacon schema has fixed fields and strict decoding bounds.
notes: Schema codec is tested; radio transmission is separately partial.

requirement_summary: Parsers reject non-canonical forms, unknown critical data, trailing bytes, and excessive bounds; golden vectors and fuzzing are mandatory.
notes: DISC-004 and DISC-005: local negative tests/harnesses exist, but no committed vectors or fuzz-run evidence fulfils the mandates.

requirement_summary: Node lifecycle gates start, radio activation, degraded mode, shutdown, and failure containment.
notes: Node orchestration exists but is not a direct implementation of every named lifecycle state.

requirement_summary: Tier ladder transitions enforce role, battery, and capability restrictions for Core through Anchor.
notes: Tier values are represented; exhaustive tier-transition FSM evidence is absent.

requirement_summary: Per-peer session FSM sequences handshake, proof, summary, reconciliation, transfer, close, and timeout safely.
notes: Normal full-sync and timeout paths are tested, not all malformed transitions.

requirement_summary: Bundle lifecycle state tracks receipt, expiry, eviction, offer, handoff, and purge invariants.
notes: Store state exists; complete FSM transition-table/property evidence was not located.

requirement_summary: Friendship FSM manages offer, mutual claim, proxy buffering, polling, expiry, and renewal.
notes: Wire variants exist, but session intentionally ignores friendship frames.

requirement_summary: Blob assembly states, retry timers, session timeouts, and tier-specific timers remain bounded and testable.
notes: Blob frames are advisory/ignored in session; timer table is not fully realized.

requirement_summary: Bundle, seen, profile, receipt, and blob stores have stated durability, quotas, and range-iteration responsibilities.
notes: Checksummed snapshot tests exist; flash-log/blob durability and all specified store roles are not implemented.

requirement_summary: MMPSNAP2 snapshot records, checksums, and corruption-drop recovery are local implementation choices.
notes: Do not teach MMPSNAP2 as an MMP interoperability requirement.

requirement_summary: Simulator must validate routing, reconciliation, capacity, latency, and scale assumptions rather than merely demonstrate a contact loop.
notes: Deterministic 10/30-node tests exist; no 1k/10k, BLE-loss, mobility, or statistical validation exists.

requirement_summary: Battery target and failure drills require measured phone energy, long fuzzing, and platform/OEM exercises.
notes: Required validation drills are not implemented as audited executable evidence.

requirement_summary: Whole-phone energy multiplier must be measured; planning band must be internally consistent before a gate.
notes: DISC-002: doc 13 uses k_sys [4,12], while OQ-13 still states [3,10].

requirement_summary: Workspace layers keep types, crypto, core, router, storage, node, TAL, and FFI responsibilities separated with no_std lower layers.
notes: Layer check enforces a bounded subset of the planned dependency rule.

requirement_summary: Reference implementation exposes app/FFI seam and structured diagnostics independently of the user event stream.
notes: FFI and diagnostics interfaces exist; platform binding execution is not evidenced.

requirement_summary: Golden vectors for every frame/bundle type must be fixed-key, include specified negative cases, and be cross-checked by an independent decoder.
notes: DISC-004: vectors directory explicitly contains no committed vectors.

requirement_summary: Parser fuzz targets, allocation checks, and CI target matrix are mandatory verification work.
notes: DISC-005 and DISC-006: harnesses exist, but no run/corpus evidence or audited required target-matrix evidence exists.

requirement_summary: File manifests, object roots, symbol bundles, and blob-plane bindings have bounded schemas and integrity semantics.
notes: Manifest/frame codecs exist; end-to-end file transfer does not.

requirement_summary: Thumbnail, album, fetch-policy, quota, and airtime rules prevent attachments from silently dominating relay resources.
notes: Parser limits exist but no audited thumbnail/fetch/airtime policy implementation exists.

requirement_summary: File-transfer abuse defenses require bounds, verification, and quota-aware behavior.
notes: Generic quota exists; file-specific abuse path is not integrated.

requirement_summary: File and thumbnail constants are provisional and require measurement before product claims.
notes: Treat as a measurement design exercise, not a settled implementation target.

requirement_summary: Profiles are versioned tuning/conformance vectors with zero wire-format change and drill pass-bands.
notes: Profiles are extension-phase methodology with no audited profile loader or validator.

requirement_summary: Train A, Train B, and campus profiles bind roles, physical contact assumptions, retuned constants, and honest degradation.
notes: Use as deployment-case analysis; claims remain provisional pending drills.

requirement_summary: Profile drills require train/campus scenarios in the simulator before acceptance.
notes: No audited S-8/S-9 profile scenarios are committed.

requirement_summary: Authority certificates use corrected claim field 0x07, scoped issuer/subject signatures, and explicit trust-root provisioning.
notes: Certificate codec/verification exists; root provisioning remains unresolved.

requirement_summary: Announcements bind authority assertions to signed bundles and class-specific payload semantics.
notes: Named node test covers a valid attached certificate path.

requirement_summary: Priority admission is authority-gated, receive-time clamped, and bounded by per-authority token buckets.
notes: Budget cap test exists; honest-receiver residual remains specified.

requirement_summary: Revocation is signed, gossiped, sticky, and clamps previously elevated subjects.
notes: Direct integration test covers sticky revocation behavior.

requirement_summary: Authority abuse analysis records queue-jump, Sybil, root-compromise, and state-persistence residuals.
notes: Implementation keeps authority buckets in RAM; audit does not establish deployment-grade persistence or root compromise handling.

requirement_summary: The sensor lifetime analogy cites F-A6, which must resolve to a traceable evidence chain rather than an orphan token.
notes: DISC-003: F-A6 is a finding label and is not a source-register identifier; its indirect [A23][A24] lineage needs an explicit join.
